title: Agent37 Launches New AI Cloud Sandboxes for $4.76 Monthly to Challenge Vercel
summary:
Agent37 has introduced a new cloud infrastructure service designed to lower the overhead for developers deploying autonomous AI agents. The company's pricing for a month long setup featuring 2 vCPUs and 4 GB RAM is $4.76, contrasting with the $249 monthly fee for a similar configuration at Vercel, $145 at Cloudflare, and $121 at Daytona.

The platform runs various harnesses, including Claude Code and Codex, within gVisor sandboxes that include individual filesystems and hard disk quotas. The lower price point is intended to make it economically viable for application developers to provide every user with their own permanent agent for tasks such as building software or analyzing files.
